exposure: History of cannabis use (ever vs. never)
Views about the legal status of cannabis
outcome: Willingness to use cannabis for gynecological conditions (e.g., pain, procedural pain)
cohort: U.S. women aged 18 years and older (N=995) who completed an online survey regarding cannabis use, attitudes, and willingness to use cannabis for gynecological conditions.
finding: Women with a history of cannabis use were significantly more willing to use cannabis for gynecological conditions compared to never users, with this willingness also associated with views supporting cannabis legality.
cross-section timing: N/A (data collected via survey, specific dates not provided beyond publication year 2021)
